densityHelp: Compact packs the panels together and takes away the gap between them.
themeDayHelp: Used while the system looks light.
themeManualHelp: The theme the window keeps, whatever the system looks like.
themeModeHelp: Follow the system, with a theme for day and another for night, or hold one theme.
themeNightHelp: Used while the system looks dark.
themesIntro: A theme changes colours and contrast. It never moves anything: sizes, shortcuts and panels stay where they are.
updatesChannelHelp: Beta receives the test versions; Stable only the ones published for everyone.
updatesModeHelp: Automatic looks and downloads; Notify looks and waits for you to download; Manual only looks when you ask. It never restarts by itself.
updatesBusy: An update is already being looked for.
updatesUnsupported: This install does not update from the app.
proxyModeSystemHelp: Requests go the way the operating system says, its automatic configuration included.
proxyModeEnvironmentHelp: Requests read HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, ALL_PROXY and NO_PROXY from the environment Mandor was started in.
proxyModeCustomHelp: Requests go through the proxy written below.
proxyModeNoneHelp: Requests go straight to the server, whatever the system says.
proxyUrlHelp: Scheme, host and port. HTTP, HTTPS and SOCKS5; SOCKS4 only for connections.
proxyBypassHelp: Hosts that go straight to the server, separated by commas. *.example.com covers the hosts under it, .example.com the domain too.
proxyUsernameHelp: Leave it empty when the proxy asks for nothing.
secretRefused: The keychain did not take it. What you typed is still here.
caFilesHelp: PEM files trusted beside the authorities Mandor ships with: the root of a company, or of a server that signs its own certificate.
clientCertificatesHelp: The certificate shown to a host that asks the client for one. The first whose host matches is shown.
certificateRemoveDetail: {{name}} and its passphrase leave this machine. This cannot be undone.
certificateHostHelp: api.example.com, *.example.com, or host:port to hold the port.
certificatePfxHelp: Takes the place of the certificate and the key.
aboutLicensesHelp: Those of every library the app carries inside.
runScriptsHelp: Off, no script runs and the console says how many were left out. Nothing is deleted and nothing loses its approval.
forgetApprovalsHelp: Every script approved on this machine asks to be approved again before it runs.
forgetApprovalsDetail: Every script asks to be approved again on this machine. The scripts themselves stay as they are.
motionHelp: System does what the system asks. Reduced takes away sliding and growing and keeps the fades.
askUnsavedHelp: Off, closing a tab with changes lets them go.
alwaysNewTab: Always open in a new tab
alwaysNewTabHelp: A click in the sidebar keeps its tab instead of opening it as a preview.
closedTabsKeptHelp: How many closed tabs can be reopened.
editorFontFamilyHelp: The font the editors write in. Empty uses the font of Mandor.
editorFontSizeHelp: The size the editors open at; zooming the text still scales it.
editorIndentSizeHelp: Columns one level of code steps in, when typing and when formatting.
editorIndentTypeHelp: Spaces or tabs, when typing and when formatting.
editorAutoCloseHelp: Typing an opening bracket or quote writes its closing one.
editorWordWrapHelp: Lines longer than the editor continue below instead of scrolling sideways.
historyEntriesHelp: Past it, the oldest go when the next send is written.
activityEntriesHelp: Past it, the oldest messages and events of a connection leave the list.
